protocol.train: September 2026 only; purge labels crossing October
protocol.target: Independent long/short net R from observed bid/ask tick barrier or five-minute timeout; labels calculated ONLY for training rows
protocol.entry: Choose higher predicted long/short net R if >0.10R and exceeds opposite prediction by >0.05R; no quota
protocol.execution: Retained original bid/ask ticks; 200/500ms delays, commission3.5/lot/side, slippage.02/.05, .01 lot floors,100oz contract,100x leverage,50%entrymargin,15%daily/60%peak experimental limits
protocol.acceptance: At $500/1%: positive net expectancy >=0.15R and PF>=1.4 in BOTH validation and test under base and stressed costs; >=5 decisions per observed weekday in each. These are product screening criteria, never entry quotas.
limitations: October was viewed in earlier research; new model fitting is chronologically separated but market period is not pristine unseen data.
No feature/threshold/hyperparameter selection using validation or test results. No defaults promotion based on one month.
Conditional-return estimation does not itself establish a tradeable edge. No annualization or monthly growth guarantee.
protocol.label_limitations: Fixed200ms entry delay, adverse .02 tick rounding and .07/oz round-trip commission; timeout first quote after hold+200ms. Independent labels omit account admission and are not exact native broker execution.
protocol.objective_change: Execution-aligned objective, same fixed feature set, hyperparameters, geometry and dates; prior close-price-target failures preserved.
protocol.reason: Chronological month-to-month test of the same fixed linear execution-value model; nonlinear model rejected, no hyperparameter retuning. September source restored to the exact previously recorded hash.

source_manifests.volumeMeaning: Observed quote count, not traded volume
limitations: Exness Raw Spread reference; not JustMarkets or a prop firm fill record

Commission, latency, fill reserve and lot/margin rules are scenarios
